17	// Per-file upload status, driven by a sequential (concurrency = 1) worker.
18	// A module-level singleton (like ../../lib/pageCache) rather than a hook:
19	// there is only ever one upload run in flight for the app, so the queue's
20	// lifetime doesn't need to be tied to any one component instance. Callers
21	// resolve each file's destination folder/name up front and pass in an
22	// ordered list of jobs — this module only knows how to run them one at a
23	// time and track status, not about the file tree or Drive assignments.
24	const filesByPath = new Map<string, UploadEntry>()
25	let pendingPaths: string[] = []
26	const listeners = new Set<() => void>()
27	let running = false
28	let cancelled = false
29	
30	function notify() {
31	  for (const fn of listeners) fn()
32	}
33	
34	export function subscribe(fn: () => void): () => void {
35	  listeners.add(fn)
36	  return () => listeners.delete(fn)
37	}
38	
39	export function useUploadQueueRender() {
40	  const [, setTick] = useState(0)
41	  useEffect(() => subscribe(() => setTick(t => t + 1)), [])
42	}
43	
44	export function getStatus(path: string): UploadEntry | undefined {
45	  return filesByPath.get(path)
46	}
47	
48	// True once none of the given files are still queued or uploading — i.e.
49	// each has either reached a terminal state (done/error) or was never
50	// started. Callers use this to know when it's safe to let the upload
51	// modal close.
52	export function hasSettled(paths: string[]): boolean {
53	  return !paths.some(path => {
54	    const status = filesByPath.get(path)?.status
55	    return status === 'queued' || status === 'uploading'
56	  })
57	}
58	
59	function updateStatus(path: string, status: UploadStatus, error?: string) {
60	  const existing = filesByPath.get(path)!
61	  filesByPath.set(path, { ...existing, status, error })
62	  notify()
63	}
64	
65	async function runQueue() {
66	  if (running) return
67	  running = true
68	  while (!cancelled && pendingPaths.length > 0) {
69	    const path = pendingPaths.shift()!
70	    const job = filesByPath.get(path)!
71	    updateStatus(path, 'uploading')
72	    try {
73	      await UploadFile(job.path, job.folderId, job.name)
74	      updateStatus(path, 'done')
75	    } catch (e) {
76	      updateStatus(path, 'error', String(e))
77	    }
78	  }
79	  running = false
80	}
81	
82	function enqueue(newJobs: UploadJob[]) {
83	  if (newJobs.length === 0) return
84	  cancelled = false
85	  for (const job of newJobs) {
86	    filesByPath.set(job.path, { ...job, status: 'queued', error: undefined })
87	    pendingPaths.push(job.path)
88	  }
89	  notify()
90	  void runQueue()
91	}
92	
93	export function start(newJobs: UploadJob[]): void {
94	  enqueue(newJobs)
95	}
96	
97	export function retry(job: UploadJob): void {
98	  enqueue([job])
99	}

102	// still waiting their turn go back to idle since they were never attempted.
103	export function cancelRemaining(): void {
104	  cancelled = true

So I just shortened the comment to point at `hasSettled()` by name instead. Typecheck and tests pass.

it('Upload All stays disabled until every file resolves to a Drive folder', async () => {
    await setupWithTree()
    expect(isDisabled('Upload All')).toBe(true)

    await assignAllFolders()

    expect(isDisabled('Upload All')).toBe(false)
  })

  it('clicking Upload All runs every file and shows terminal status in the modal', async () => {
    await setupWithTree()
    await assignAllFolders()
    vi.mocked(UploadFile).mockResolvedValue('drive-id')

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Upload All' }))

    expect(await screen.findByText('Uploading to Drive')).toBeTruthy()

    await waitFor(() => expect(UploadFile).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(3))
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getAllByText('✓ Uploaded').length).toBe(3))
    expect(isDisabled('Close')).toBe(false)

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Close' }))
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.queryByText('Uploading to Drive')).toBeNull())
  })

  it('a failed file shows an inline Retry that re-queues just that file', async () => {
    await setupWithTree()
    await assignAllFolders()
    vi.mocked(UploadFile).mockRejectedValueOnce(new Error('quota exceeded')).mockResolvedValue('drive-id')

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Upload All' }))

    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByText(/quota exceeded/)).toBeTruthy())
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getAllByText('✓ Uploaded').length).toBe(2))
    expect(isDisabled('Close')).toBe(false) // run reached a terminal rest state, even with a failure showing

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Retry' }))
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getAllByText('✓ Uploaded').length).toBe(3))
    expect(screen.queryByText(/quota exceeded/)).toBeNull()
  })

  it('Cancel remaining reverts queued files without touching the one already in flight', async () => {
    await setupWithTree()
    await assignAllFolders()
    let resolveFirst: (v: string) => void = () => {}
    vi.mocked(UploadFile).mockImplementation(() => new Promise<string>(res => { resolveFirst = res }))

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Upload All' }))
    await waitFor(() => expect(UploadFile).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1))

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Cancel remaining' }))
    expect(screen.getAllByText('Not uploaded').length).toBe(2)
    expect(isDisabled('Close')).toBe(true) // the in-flight file hasn't resolved yet

    resolveFirst('drive-id')
    await waitFor(() => expect(isDisabled('Close')).toBe(false))
  })
})

-// Callers must only invoke this once the queue is idle (nothing queued or
-// uploading) — in the UI, that's guaranteed by the upload modal staying
-// open and blocking the root-folder picker until every file reaches a
-// terminal state. If that ever stops holding, a request from the discarded
-// run could still be in flight and would resurface after this call.
 export function reset(): void {
+  if (!hasSettled(Array.from(filesByPath.keys()))) {
+    // Callers must only invoke this once hasSettled() is true for all files;
+    // otherwise a request from the discarded run could still be in flight and
+    // would resurface after this call.
+    throw new Error('reset() called while an upload is still in flight')
+  }
